title_as_printed: Enthalpies of Dilution, Delta_dil H, of Aqueous Salt Solutions at Various Temperatures

footnotes_as_printed.a: N is the number of duplicate experiments.
footnotes_as_printed.b: Delta_dil H is the average experimental enthalpy of dilution.
footnotes_as_printed.c: sigma_e is the error of Delta_dil H estimated from the scatter of the N points and the calorimetric behavior.
footnotes_as_printed.d: Delta is Delta_dil H(calcd by eq 1) minus Delta_dil H(exptl).
footnotes_as_printed.e: These experiments were not included in the least-squares fit because deviations from the fit were greater than 2 sigma.

pressure_note: The pressures were kept constant at 0.1-0.3 MPa greater than the water vapor pressure at the experimental temperature (Experimental Section); no pressure printed per row

value.what: printed column is -Delta_dil H (average enthalpy of dilution per mole of salt, from initial molality m_i to final molality m_f); value = printed x -1 gives Delta_dil H

salt_from_label_row.what: initial molality; final molality is column m_f (mol kg-1)

composition.other_species: pure water; one salt per block (MgCl2, Na2SO4, K2SO4 or MgSO4), no other species

extra_unmapped: Delta (J mol-1) (difference calculated by eq 1 minus experimental, fit residual)
notes: Block (E) Na2SO4 423.65 K is printed in two column groups (left then right); stacked as left then right without a second label row. Blocks F-I have no Delta column printed (cells empty). Salt of each block is in the label row. Row 0.00765e (block C) carries footnote e.
quality_remarks: audit 2026-10-02: CSV data row 98 (MgSO4 block, 373.15 K) prints m_i = 0.00832 with m_f = 0.00191; m_f is m_i/2 in every other row and the neighbouring row ends 0.00382, so 0.00832 is probably a misprint for 0.00382. Kept as printed. The row at 0.00765 mol/kg MgCl2, 472.95 K carries footnote e (excluded from the authors' fit, deviation > 2 sigma).
